conclusion: On this Windows host, these four normal action-process exits were not restarted despite native RestartOnFailure PT1M/Count1. Neither DWORD3 versus FFFFFFFF nor manual versus timer dispatch changed the observation. This is not proof of every possible Task Scheduler failure/retry behavior.

original_campaign_diagnosis.entry_source_fact: supervised_service.py records launch_requested=False but does not reject entry on that flag; draining in the current logon session is a distinct stop latch.
original_campaign_diagnosis.original_task_history: Exact task already removed before read-only COM query (0x80070002); TaskScheduler Operational log disabled. No global log setting was changed.
original_campaign_diagnosis.limitation: Original crash campaign has zero replacement READY observations, not a proven native attempt count. The separate OS matrix provides direct process-exit observations without rewriting that campaign.
